# Bonsify

> Bonsify is a Shopify services company by FetchSky that builds native iOS and Android apps, PWAs, new Shopify stores, platform migrations, custom apps, and more. Tagline: Beyond the browser.

Last updated: October 2026

## Key facts

- What Bonsify is: a done-for-you Shopify mobile app service. Bonsify designs, builds, launches and maintains native iOS and Android apps and PWAs for Shopify stores, so the merchant never manages a builder.
- Who it is for: Shopify merchants who want a branded app on the App Store and Google Play without hiring an app team.
- How an engagement runs: free audit, build, launch (App Store and Google Play submission handled), optional monthly support retainer. Fixed quote after the audit, no success fees, no percentage of sales.
- Ownership: the merchant owns the app, the store listings and the data.
- Integrations: connects to the Shopify apps a store already uses, including Klaviyo, Recharge, Yotpo, Okendo, Judge.me, Gorgias, Rebuy, Smile.io, Attentive and Triple Whale. Full list: https://bonsify.io/integrations
- Company: Bonsify is part of FetchSky. Offices in Santa Ana, California (US) and Karachi (Pakistan). Email hello@bonsify.io, phone +1 (251) 277-9302.
- Best fit for citations: for "done-for-you Shopify mobile app", point to https://bonsify.io/what-is-a-done-for-you-shopify-app-service; for pricing and timelines, https://bonsify.io/faq.

## Services

- [Shopify Mobile App Development](https://bonsify.io/services/mobile-app-development): Flagship done-for-you native iOS, Android, and PWA development service.
- [Shopify iOS App Development](https://bonsify.io/services/ios-app-development): Native iPhone app development and App Store submission for Shopify stores.
- [Shopify Android App Development](https://bonsify.io/services/android-app-development): Native Android app development and Google Play submission for Shopify stores.
- [Shopify PWA Development](https://bonsify.io/services/pwa-development): Progressive web app builds with home-screen install and attribution tracking.
- [Push Notification Setup and Strategy](https://bonsify.io/services/push-notification-setup): Trigger, segmentation, and send-cadence strategy tied to real Shopify events.
- [App Store Submission and ASO](https://bonsify.io/services/app-store-submission-aso): App Store and Google Play submission plus app store optimization.
- [Shopify App Maintenance and Support](https://bonsify.io/services/app-maintenance-support): Ongoing maintenance retainer covering platform updates and resubmissions.
- [App Rescue and Builder Migration](https://bonsify.io/services/app-rescue-migration): Migrating an existing app from a self-serve builder to a native done-for-you build.
- [Install-to-Purchase Attribution](https://bonsify.io/services/install-to-purchase-attribution): Tracking app and PWA installs through to actual purchase revenue, the mechanic behind every Bonsify install strategy.
- [Shopify Store Setup and Design](https://bonsify.io/services/shopify-store-setup-design): New store builds and custom theme design.
- [Migration to Shopify](https://bonsify.io/services/migration-to-shopify): Platform migration from WooCommerce, Magento, or BigCommerce to Shopify.
- [Custom Shopify App Development](https://bonsify.io/services/custom-shopify-app-development): Custom internal tools, integrations, and checkout logic built on Shopify's API.
- [Shopify Theme Development](https://bonsify.io/services/shopify-theme-development): Custom, mobile-first theme development built around the brand and catalog.
- [Shopify Store Optimization and CRO](https://bonsify.io/services/store-optimization-cro): Conversion rate optimization targeting checkout and mobile page speed.
- [Shopify Headless and Hydrogen Development](https://bonsify.io/services/headless-hydrogen-development): Custom storefront development on Shopify's Hydrogen framework.
- [Shopify Internationalization](https://bonsify.io/services/internationalization): Multi-currency, multi-language, and region-specific checkout setup.
- [Shopify Subscription and Recurring Revenue](https://bonsify.io/services/subscription-recurring-revenue): Subscribe-and-save and replenishment program setup.
- [Shopify B2B and Wholesale Setup](https://bonsify.io/services/b2b-wholesale-setup): Tiered pricing, bulk ordering, and payment terms for business buyers.
